title: Draft: SAE J2735: Added SAE J2735:2024 dissector
description:
Due to SAE license limitations ASN.1 files cannot be upstreamed, only
the derivate work. Template, cnf and patch files are upstreamed for
reference along with the generated .c file.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 89415c24 - SAE J2735: Added SAE J2735:2024 dissector
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22117/diffs?diff_id=1547501985&start_sha=93329e865b0e81e1a55c4bb07c50b11755b10e46)
Unfortunate I don't think this can be merged as we can't regenerate the generated file ourselfs if there is any api changes or any change to asn2wrs generator.

We (Commsignia) can regenerate the files if necessary. So if such a change happens you can let us know (Sorry i do not know what the process is when such a change happens).
The reason we would like to merge this is that this is a very much needed feature by the V2X industry members in Wireshark and it would be great if this could be part of the official Wireshark release.

Unfortunately I think the industry will have to try to influence the license on the asn1 files to something that would allow the wireshark organization to have them in the git repo. ETSI for instance have the ITS asn1 files available.

I think our ci regenerate the asn1 files and ensure no editing on the generated files occurs that might fail here.

Anyways you can fix the build errors as a start.

It took a long time just to get the license for upstreaming the derivative work and I don't think SAE will allow the upstreaming of the ASN.1 files themselves. They made it quite clear during the process.
Anyway I fixed the build errors. The remaining one is I think due to the python script's (./tools/check_typed_item_calls.py) indentation error.

This part shall have one more indent

```py
        else:
            # It needs to have a non-zero mask.
            if self.mask_read and self.mask_value == 0:
                print('Error:', self.filename, self.hf, 'is in fields array', arr, 'but has a zero mask - this is not allowed')
                global errors_found
                errors_found += 1

```
It's Sharkfest next week in Warsaw. Core devs will have a chance to discuss there.

I will leave this merge request open until then.
Can you please drop a feedback here about the outcome of the discussion?

Sure. But I'm doubtful as in how to maintain something we can not recreate the code for. Maybe by booting it out every time it breaks...

There is also https://github.com/nprobert/Wireshark-J2735

Unfortunately I don't think we can accept this contribution. For one I don't think this exeption 

 _\* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later_ 

 _\*/_ 

_/\*_ 

 _\* This product contains SAE International copyrighted intellectual_ 

 _\* property, which has been and is licensed with permission for use_ 

 _\* by Commsignia in this code only._ 

 _\*_ 

 _\* Generated from SAE J2735™ (September 2024) ASN.1 files_ 

 _\* © SAE International. All rights reserved._ 

 _\*/_

_goes with GPL and not having the asn1 makes it impossible to maintan and review the actual code._

You should probably make a plugin and distribute that to your users.

That's okay, we will compile the plugin ourselves and distribute it. Thanks for the feedback.
Shall I close this merge request?

Hi Marton,
yes please, there is no reason to keep it open for now. Feel free to reopen it if SAE change their mind ate some point, we will happily integrate the dissector upstream.
